quantity: thermophysical volume-equivalent diameter fitted with this shape model
reference: DAMIT model 390 calibrated size, Hanuš et al. (2015), Icarus 256, 101
notes: DAMIT marks model 390 as size-calibrated by the thermophysical fit of Hanuš et al. (2015): D = 16.4 ± 1.3 km, thermal inertia 170 (90–260), geometric albedo 0.21 ± 0.04. The mirror pole, model 391, fits D = 16.8 ± 1.5 km. NEOWISE lists 15.812 ± 0.111 km (Masiero et al. 2014) and 17.739 ± 0.894 km (Masiero et al. 2012).
